model._hint: Fine-tune: ogkalu/Comic-Diffusion v2 (SD 1.5 base). All 6 comic styles trained simultaneously. ~2 GB; no sequential offload needed.

generation._hint: 20–30 steps. 25 is a good default. | CFG 7–8 recommended. | SD 1.5 native 512×512. 768×512 works for landscape compositions.

system._hint: ~2 GB peak; sequential_cpu_offload: disabled (model fits in unified memory)

triggers.description: Charlie Bo style — clean geometric shapes, bold outlines, vibrant flat colours
Hollie Mengert style — soft rounded shapes, warm pastel tones, storybook illustration feel
Mario Alberti style — detailed linework, rich colours, classic European comic aesthetic
Pepe Larraz style — dynamic action compositions, precise anatomy, Marvel/DC superhero style
Andreas Rocha style — painterly landscapes, rich atmospheric lighting, fantasy environments
James Daly style — expressive character portraits, bold contrast, classic comic storytelling

notes.about: Generates comic illustrations in one of 6 distinct artstyles, all baked into a single SD 1.5 fine-tune (ogkalu/Comic-Diffusion v2). Mix multiple style tokens in one prompt to blend styles.
notes.prompt_guide:
TRIGGER WORD REQUIRED — pick one (or combine several):
• charliebo artstyle — geometric flat colour
• holliemengert artstyle — storybook pastels
• marioalberti artstyle — European comic detail
• pepelarraz artstyle — superhero action
• andreasrocha artstyle — painterly fantasy
• jamesdaly artstyle — expressive portraits

Examples: 'a superhero in action, pepelarraz artstyle', 'foggy forest path, andreasrocha artstyle', 'portrait of a spy, charliebo artstyle marioalberti artstyle'.
